# Attachment

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("Attachment")`

A named point on a part, with a position and an orientation. Use it as a socket to weld something to, as the anchor of a constraint, or as the place where an effect is emitted. It has no physics body.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CFrame` | `CFrame` | — | read/write | The position and orientation of the attachment relative to the part it is parented to. |
| `WorldCFrame` | `CFrame` | — | read-only | The position and orientation of the attachment in world space. It is updated every tick as the part moves. |

## Methods

### `GetRenderCFrame(): CFrame`

Returns where this attachment is drawn in the current frame, which is between its positions at the last two simulation ticks. Use it for anything that must line up with the picture, such as a camera that follows the attachment.

It differs from `WorldCFrame` only inside a render step: a function bound with `RunService:BindToRenderStep`, a `PreRender` handler, or an action whose context has `Rate = Render`. Everywhere else, including on a server, it returns `WorldCFrame`.
